analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is consolidating near the 52-week low, forming an accumulation phase. While the MACD histogram shows signs of improvement, subdued volume makes a trend reversal uncertain.
keyPoints: RSI가 39.9로 중립 구간에 머물며 방향성 부재를 시사한다.
